meta.name: The Hanged Man
meta.description:
Title: The Hanged Man
Summary: Miraculously still alive after his hanging, gunfighter James Devlin defends a young widow's farm from a vicious land grabber.
Directed by: Michael Caffey
Actors: Steve Forrest, Dean Jagger, Will Geer
Production Company: Andrew J. Fenady Productions
Release Date: TV Movie 13 March 1974
Aspect Ratio: 1.33 : 1
   A gunfighter who survives his own hanging helps a young widow who is trying to keep a ruthless land baron from taking her ranch.
